column1: # MANUALLY MANAGED - reviewed bytes of the pinned GOG HEROES3.EXE that no
# LINK run produces: edits made after linking. `homm3 verify link-diff`
# compares the candidate link with retail whose stated bytes are reverted
# to `link`, after checking that retail holds `retail` there.
# Evidence: the archived European Collector's Edition HEROES3.EXE (SHA-256
# 0x39b83835, entry point and section starts: it is the same link. Every
# `link` value below is its byte, and LINK's own behaviour agrees (zero
# checksum without /RELEASE, no load-configuration directory, Characteristics
# kind `bytes`: `offset` is a file offset, `size` bytes long; `retail` and
# `link` are the bytes in hex. kind `import-*` rows state an import-table
# rule instead, since those bytes move with the import data:
#   import-dll-name  dll  spelling   retail spells the DLL name `retail`
#   import-hints     dll  0          every hint of the DLL is zero in retail;
#                                    LINK writes the import library's hint
#   import-timestamp *    hex        retail descriptor TimeDateStamp; LINK 0
#   import-orphan    rva  name       a hint/name string no thunk references
# Not stated here, because the source reproduces them: the arithmetic and
# default sample-rate differences the same comparison shows
